name: presence-outline
title: Presence outline
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Outlines and labels an element when another person's selection presence matches.

meta.descriptionEs: Dibuja el contorno y el nombre de quien tiene seleccionado ese elemento.

examples.title: Campos
examples.description: Brief y notas con la selección de la sala.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Nadie, una persona y nombres largos.

api.name: selection
api.description: Value compared with the other user's selection.

api.name: className / labelClassName
api.description: Classes for the wrapper and the name label.

docs: Requires PresenceProvider. The outline color is info.color or a chart token. Several people on the same target show the first name plus a count.
